targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('hour', asked_at) AS time, count(*) AS questions FROM app.messages WHERE $__timeFilter(asked_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Route distribution
panels.description: docs = answered from retrieved docs, refused = out of scope, error = pipeline failure

targets.rawSql: SELECT route, count(*) AS questions FROM app.messages WHERE $__timeFilter(asked_at) GROUP BY route
SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.rating = 1) AS "👍 up", count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.rating = -1) AS "👎 down" FROM app.feedback f JOIN app.messages m ON m.id = f.message_id WHERE $__timeFilter(m.asked_at)

SELECT date_trunc('hour', asked_at) AS time, avg(latency_ms) AS avg_ms, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) AS p95_ms FROM app.messages WHERE $__timeFilter(asked_at) AND latency_ms IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Top retrieval score (grounding proxy)
panels.description: Score of the best-ranked chunk per question — a falling trend means questions are drifting away from what the corpus covers

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('hour', asked_at) AS time, avg((retrieved_chunks->0->>'score')::float) AS top_score FROM app.messages WHERE $__timeFilter(asked_at) AND jsonb_array_length(retrieved_chunks) > 0 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT m.asked_at AS "asked", left(m.question, 90) AS "question", m.route, m.latency_ms AS "ms", coalesce(f.rating::text, '') AS "rating" FROM app.messages m LEFT JOIN app.feedback f ON f.message_id = m.id WHERE $__timeFilter(m.asked_at) ORDER BY m.asked_at DESC LIMIT 25
